svg.title: A Quarto document
svg.desc: One box, labelled hello.qmd, your content, holding a short Quarto document: a YAML header setting title to Hello, then the line Hello asterisk asterisk world asterisk asterisk exclamation mark. The value Hello and the body line are teal.
